separationRule: The root route is the visitor-facing entry page. Studio Hub is treated as an internal/operator gateway and is not part of the public visitor build. This contract controls visitor-facing publication only; it does not replace, narrow, or mutate the operational release manifest or its validator.
approvalRule: Only entries in approvedRoutes with status approved may be published. Candidate routes are evidence for review, not publication permission.

reviewFindings.method: Static extraction of literal HTML href/src/action/poster/data attributes from candidate page sources on the recovery branch. This is an initial route inventory, not a complete transitive dependency or runtime security audit.
reviewFindings.result: No candidate product, service, legal, community or roadmap route is approved. Root is the only currently self-contained visitor-facing candidate; approval remains pending explicit route review and executed build tests.
reviewFindings.caveat: Inline and external CSS/JS, srcset, dynamically constructed URLs, imported assets, manifest references, forms, iframe/srcdoc and runtime navigation require additional inspection. Findings do not establish that any candidate is safe to publish.
